notes.subject: hesed
notes.rationale: חסד kept as loan word hesed per discipline; single Bambara word would flatten it

notes.subject: by thy right hand from those that rise up
notes.rationale: Hebrew word order lets 'right hand' attach either to the saving or to the attackers; KJV and JPS split differently

translation: I ka hesedw jira ka kɛ fɛn kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen ye, i min bɛ mɔgɔ minnu bɛ i la gɔn o magaw laseli i ka bolo ɲuman na, mɔgɔ minnu bɛ wuli ka u ɲɛsi.
